observations: body L2: the breathing of «Ἀρκτοφύλαξ» is printed before the capital; it is the smooth one (head on top, tail down to the left).
body L4, L15: the dammatan of «مُعْوَجٌّ» and of «جَنُوبِيٌّ» stand above the shadda in one stack (5.6 by 5.0 points).

body L5: «الثَّوْرِ» has the shadda and the fatḥa cast as one sign (4.2 by 4.1 points) and a kasra under the tail of the rāʾ, 6.0 points below the baseline (over «gittarii» of L6). The figure after ν is a superscript 2, printed heavy with its counter filled.

body L7: the middle digit of «١٣٤» has two crests (a 3); the reference spans 6.4 points from the stem of the 3 to the top of the 4, the 2 and the 4 of «٢٢٤» on p. 346 span 5.2 points. The reference of note (2) is the same «١٣٤».

body L7, L9: «ἑῴα» has the rough breathing on the epsilon (the sort with the head opening to the right, as in «ἑσπερία» on p. 346); «ἀνα-» (L7), «ἀπηλιώτης» (L10) and «ὀψινὸς» (L20) have the smooth breathing, as on p. 346.

body L12, L13: «١٣٨{2}» (L12) and «١٣٣{8}» (L13) have 3s with two crests (4.7-4.8 points); «١٢٣{9}» (L12) has a 2 with one crest (3.1 points) before its 3; «١٥٢» (L13) ends in a 2 (3.0 points) joined to the 5.
body L13: «(cfr. l. 20,» has the lowercase l (7.8 points tall, the height of the ascenders), not the numeral I. A speck is printed over the u of «punctorum»; not transcribed.
body L14: the dash after «22).» is 7.0 points long, shorter than the other em dashes of the page (9.8-10.4 points); transcribed —. The kasra under the wāw of «شَتَوِيَّةٌ» touches the letter.
body L15: «٢٩» is a 2 joined to a 9 (5.8 points). A speck (0.9 by 0.7 point) is printed over the σ of «μεσημβρινὸς»; not transcribed.
body L16: the kasra of «تَغْرِيبٌ» stands under the tail of the rāʾ, above «II» of L17.
body L17: «اخْتفاء» is printed without the article, with the sukun on the khāʾ and no other vowel sign.
body L18, L20: «الصُّبْح» has a damma with the shadda and no vowel sign under the ḥāʾ; «العَشِيَّات» (L20) has no vowel sign on the tāʾ. «تغريب» (L20) is printed with a kashīda, not transcribed.
body L19: inside the parentheses «صبحيّ» stands at the right and «التغريب» at the left; given in reading order.
body L22, L30: a speck (0.5-0.6 point) is printed on the baseline after «الغَفْرُ» (L22) and after «الغُولُ» (L30); not a full stop, not transcribed.
body L23: «غِلَظٌ» has a kasra under the ghayn, a fatḥa on the lām and the dammatan on the ẓāʾ; «ثخن» is unvowelled. The last digit of «٢١٢» has one crest (a 2, 2.9 points).
body L24: «٢٦١» and «٢٦٧» have a 2 joined to a 6 (5.6-5.8 points). «غَمَامِيٌّ» is printed with a kashīda before the yāʾ, not transcribed.
body L25: a speck (0.6 point) is printed below the line before «١٨٣»; not a zero, not transcribed.
body L26, L30: «Naǵd» has the g with the acute; «Hibintà» has the grave over the a, as on pp. 337 and 341.
notes_right L2: «ترى» is printed with a kashīda, not transcribed. The bracket at the right of «الكوكب» is printed without its lower arm.
notes_right L5: «العوّاء» has the shadda alone; «العَوَّاء» in body L31 has a fatḥa on the ʿayn and a fatḥa with the shadda.
